about_short_description.short_description: Drymerge is a developing software to let people automate tasks using plain English.

product.name: DryMerge CRM Automation
product.description: A software tool that automates CRM data entry and updates by integrating email inboxes, calendars, and call transcripts with CRM platforms using AI models.

product.name: DryMerge Coda Automations
product.description: An automation service that connects Coda documents with other applications, enabling users to create, update, and search Coda tables and documents via plain English commands.

product.name: DryMerge Google Calendar Automations
product.description: A service that automates interactions between Google Calendar and other applications, allowing creation, update, deletion, and reading of calendar events through natural language commands.

product.name: DryMerge Google Sheets Automations
product.description: An automation platform that links Google Sheets with other applications, enabling users to create, update, read, and search spreadsheet data using plain English commands.

product.name: DryMerge HubSpot Automations
product.description: A service that automates data and task management between HubSpot CRM and other applications, allowing creation, update, deletion, and reading of contacts, tickets, and companies via natural language commands.

product.name: DryMerge Microsoft OneDrive Automations
product.description: An automation service that connects Microsoft OneDrive with other applications, enabling file and folder management through plain English commands.
